question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Level (adj)
solution:
The correct answer is **Flat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Level** means a horizontal surface that is parallel to the horizon.

 
 
• **Example: ***The plane levelled off at 12000 feet.*
 
 
 
• **Flat** means an unbent, curved, or uneven surface.
 
 
• **Example**:* He has a flat desk at his home to put the books. *
 
 
 
• **Flat** and **level** are similar in meaning. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rough** means something that is not smooth or soft.
 
• **Matched** means to have the same colour or pattern as another item and to complement that item well.
 
• **Frequent** means something that happens very often.
